listings.model: Fender Fender Quantum HD 8 26x30 USB-C Audio Interface
listings.title: Fender Fender Quantum HD 8 26x30 USB-C Audio Interface
listings.description:
Built for demanding studio environments, the Fender Quantum HD 8 is a high-performance 26×30 USB-C audio interface engineered for full-band recording, multi-instrument tracking, and advanced production workflows. MAX-HD microphone preamps deliver up to +75 dB of clean gain, paired with 32-bit/192 kHz conversion for exceptional dynamic range, depth, and detail. With extensive analog and digital I/O, low-latency operation, and comprehensive software control, the Quantum HD 8 offers professional clarity and flexibility without complicating the workflow.

MAX-HD Mic Preamps: High Gain, Low Noise, Consistent Results

At the core of the Quantum HD 8 are next-generation MAX-HD mic preamps designed for transparency, headroom, and ultra-low noise. With up to +75 dB of clean gain, they accommodate condenser, dynamic, and ribbon microphones with ease—often eliminating the need for external gain boosters. Vocals remain detailed, drums retain punch and transients, and acoustic instruments preserve their natural character, ensuring reliable, repeatable results across complex multi-mic sessions.

Fender Instrument Inputs and Re-Amping Flexibility

Front-panel Fender-designed instrument inputs deliver clear, dynamic direct signals for guitars and basses, preserving articulation and natural response. Auto Gain simplifies setup, while dedicated re-amp outputs allow recorded tracks to be routed back through amps, pedals, and outboard gear for tonal refinement or creative reprocessing. This flexibility supports tracking, sound design, and hybrid production workflows.

Low-Latency Monitoring, DSP Mixing, and Loopback

Custom low-latency drivers combined with 32-bit/192 kHz conversion enable responsive real-time monitoring, even in large sessions with multiple inputs and outputs. Balanced TRS outputs support complex monitoring setups, while the onboard DSP monitor mixer provides flexible cue mixes without relying on DAW monitoring. Integrated loopback routing streamlines streaming, podcasting, and multi-application recording.

Expanded Digital I/O and Remote Control

Designed to grow with your studio, the Quantum HD 8 offers 16 channels of ADAT expansion, S/PDIF connectivity, and ADAT preamp standalone operation for seamless integration with external gear. Fender Studio Pro and Universal Control software provide full remote control of preamp gain, phantom power, routing, and monitoring from desktop or mobile devices—keeping large sessions efficient and organized.

A Scalable Interface for Professional and Hybrid Studios

With expanded I/O, MAX-HD preamps, re-amping capability, and studio-grade conversion in a rack-ready design, the Fender Quantum HD 8 delivers a reliable foundation for professional recording environments. Ideal for full-band sessions, content creation, and evolving hybrid studios, it combines high-end audio quality with streamlined control for long-term workflow efficiency.

Features  
  • 26 x 30 USB-C interface with 32-bit/192kHz converters for detailed audio
  • MAX-HD mic preamps with +75dB gain capture clean, transparent recordings
  • 16 ADAT channels and S/PDIF expand connectivity for multi-instrument setups
  • Fender instrument inputs ensure natural tone for guitars and basses
  • Auto Gain simplifies level setting for quick, accurate mic adjustments
  • Re-amp outputs allow creative amp and pedal experimentation
  • DSP monitor mixer and loopback streamline streaming and multi-app workflows
  • Universal Control app enables remote preamp and routing adjustments
  • Includes Fender Studio Pro perpetual license for professional recording tools

Fender Vintera II ’50s Nocaster MN – 2-Color Sunburst

La Fender Vintera II ’50s Nocaster MN est une Telecaster vintage moderne, parfaite pour les guitaristes à la recherche du son classique des années 50 avec le confort d’un instrument remis au goût du jour. Le manche a été décapé et lui confère une sensation satinée très agréable, rappelant le toucher des instruments vintage tout en offrant un jeu fluide sur toute la longueur du manche.

Le corps en aulne et le manche vissé en érable avec touche érable et profil Thick ’50s “U” restituent un son clair, puissant et équilibré, idéal pour le blues, le rock, le country ou le surf. Les 21 frettes Vintage Tall, le rayon de touche 7,25” et le sillet en os synthétique assurent une jouabilité authentique et confortable, fidèle aux standards Tele vintage.

Équipée de deux micros simple bobinage ’50s Tele style vintage, d’un réglage volume et tonalité uniques, et d’un sélecteur 3 positions, cette Nocaster délivre des sons twang brillants et punchy, allant des rythmiques claires aux leads expressifs. Le chevalet Tele style Vintage avec trois pontets en laiton et passage des cordes à travers le corps offre un sustain remarquable et une intonation précise. L’accastillage nickel/chrome et les mécaniques style vintage complètent le look classique de l’instrument.

Livrée avec une housse/gig bag de luxe et des cordes Fender USA 250L .009-.042, cette Telecaster est prête à jouer dès la sortie de son étui.

listings.model: Fender Custom Shop x Willcutt "Vault" Blackguard '54 Telecaster — Soft V Neck, Ron Ellis JL Pickup, Glendale Top-Loader Upgrades
listings.title: Fender Fender Custom Shop x Willcutt "Vault" Blackguard '54 Telecaster — Soft V Neck, Ron Ellis JL Pickup, Glendale Top-Loader Upgrades 2020s
listings.description:
Overview

Owned this guitar for the last year but unfortunately havent been able to play due to an injury. Been in case, in closet, so essentially in mint condition beside the custom shop aging. One of the lighter Telecasters I ever owned. Comes with some upgrades, but have all original parts in the case.

Here is more detail:

This is Willcutt Guitars and Fender Custom Shop's fourth "Vault" recreation — the Blackguard '54 Telecaster, based on their original 1954 Tele (SN 2826), one of the rarest early-'54 examples ever documented. As with previous Vault editions (the True '62, "Gloria" Tele, and the '63), this tribute is built to exacting standards: lightest-available ash body, Josefina hand-wound pickups matched to the original, custom early-'54 body contours, and a replica pickguard faithfully cloned from the source instrument. The original serial number, 2826, is stamped on the bridge plate. Light Relic aging. Custom Blonde finish. This example features the 57 Style Soft "V" neck carve (.850"–.990").

Upgrades (all original parts included)
I've upgraded this guitar from stock with parts that significantly improve playability and tone for recording. All original hardware ships with the guitar in the case:

  • Neck pickup: Ron Ellis "Julian Lage" Standard Plus JL — a phenomenal hand-wound single-coil built for neck position Tele work. Original Custom Shop Josefina neck pickup included in case if you want to swap back.
  • Bridge & hardware: Glendale Raw Deal "Top-Loader" Blackguard bridge — original no-cut bridge plate, aged to match the guitar. All original Fender Custom Shop hardware included.

Factory specs

  • Body: lightweight ash, light relic, custom early-'54 Blonde finish
  • Neck: rift sawn maple, 57 Style Soft "V" carve (.850"–.990")
  • Radius: 9.5"
  • Frets: Sanko 6105
  • Nut: bone
  • Pickups: Custom Shop Josefina hand-wound bridge; Ron Ellis JL neck (original included)
  • Tuners: vintage style with Fender logo
  • Hardware: knurled knobs, 1-ply replica pickguard
  • Bridge: Glendale Raw Deal vintage top-loader (original included)

Condition
Excellent. Light relic from the factory; no player wear beyond what Fender applied. The Glendale bridge shows appropriate aging consistent with the guitar's finish.

Includes
Willcutt-badged Fender Custom Shop hardshell case, Certificate of Authenticity, all original hardware and pickups.

listings.description:
Fender Custom Shop Limited Edition ’56 Hardtail Stratocaster Relic – Aged Olympic White

A beautifully crafted Fender Custom Shop Limited Edition ’56 Hardtail Stratocaster, finished in timeless Aged Olympic White and treated to the Custom Shop’s authentic Relic ageing process.

Inspired by the legendary Stratocasters of 1956, this Limited Edition combines period-correct character with carefully selected Custom Shop specifications designed for exceptional tone, feel and playability. Particularly noteworthy is the hardtail construction, giving this Stratocaster a distinctive response compared with traditional tremolo-equipped models.

The body is crafted from two-piece select Ash and finished in a thin Relic Flash Coat Lacquer. Combined with the fixed Vintage-Style Hardtail bridge, this construction provides a direct, immediate response with excellent resonance, sustain and note definition.

The one-piece rift-sawn Maple neck features Fender’s substantial 11/56 Off Center “V” profile, recreating the distinctive feel associated with mid-1950s Fender necks. A 7.25”–9.5” vintage compound radius preserves the comfortable vintage character in the lower positions while offering improved playability further up the neck. The 21 Medium Vintage 47095 frets complete the blend of traditional feel and practical modern refinement.

Hand-Wound Custom Shop Pickups

The guitar is equipped with a complete set of Fender Custom Shop Hand-Wound 11/56 Stratocaster single-coil pickups.

These pickups are designed to capture the clarity, dynamics and unmistakable character of a great mid-1950s Stratocaster. The middle pickup is RWRP (Reverse Wound / Reverse Polarity), providing hum-cancelling operation in the traditional in-between positions.

A 5-way selector provides access to the familiar range of Stratocaster sounds, controlled through a traditional layout of one Master Volume and two Tone controls.

Hardtail Construction

One of the defining characteristics of this Limited Edition model is its Vintage-Style Hardtail bridge. Without the traditional Stratocaster tremolo system, the strings are anchored directly through the body.

This gives the instrument its own distinctive personality, with a particularly immediate attack, excellent tuning stability and a focused, resonant response. Combined with the select Ash body and one-piece Maple neck, it makes for a highly distinctive interpretation of the classic ’56 Stratocaster formula.

A Distinctive Custom Shop Stratocaster

With its Aged Olympic White Relic finish, select Ash body, one-piece rift-sawn Maple neck, hand-wound 11/56 pickups, gold Closet Classic hardware and rare hardtail configuration, this Limited Edition ’56 Stratocaster offers something genuinely distinctive within the Fender Custom Shop range.

listings.title: Fender Fender Custom Shop LTD Heavy Relic Caballo Tono Ligero Telecaster in Dirty White Blonde 2016 - Heavy Relic
listings.description:
Limited Edition Series by Fender

Each Custom Shop Limited Edition guitar is only available for a short time, which makes it eminently collectible while also adding to its investment value. Crafted with many features normally reserved only for select artists and master-built instruments, these instruments are exactly what their name says – highly anticipated limited edition models.

For 2015, the Custom Shop proudly introduced an expanded selection of premium »relic» finishes that have been designed to replicate the worn-in vibe of a genuine vintage instrument. The Heavy Relic finish is the heaviest of the Custom Shop treatments, evoking decades of the most punishing playing and touring. Each one is specially devised to capture the authenticity of the original-era, with unparalleled breathability and resonance.

Premium Features of the Fender Custom Shop Limited Edition Caballo Tono Ligero Telecaster

This Custom Shop Limited Edition Heavy Relic Tele presents an enlightened new take on Fender’s original workhorse tone machine – the name translates to »Light Tone Horse Tele», which perfectly suits the chambered Thinline Ash body complemented by a single F hole. This unqiue instrument is equipped with a TV Jones® Classic neck pickup, hand-wound »Red Hot» bridge pickup and stacked 250/500k volume control, providing you with pure power and versatility. Other premium features include a one-piece AA flame Maple neck, »Limited Edition» engraved neck plate, a three-way switch on a reverse control plate, RSD telecaster bridge, pearl buttons, Custom Shop case and a certificate of authenticity.

The Limited Edition Caballo Tono Ligero Telecaster comes complete with a stunning dirty white blonde finish and nitrocellulose lacquer, imparting the appearance of years of aging and use without the need for heavy wear and tear.

Unrivaled Quality and Craftsmanship

Since 1987, the skilled craftsmen in Fender’s Corona, California »dream factory» have been producing guitars that are known worldwide for their artistry and unrivaled quality. Ranging from the fine to the fantastic, whether it’s building a new custom instrument from the ground up or modifying an existing one, their best is the best. These wonderful instruments have been crafted for and with the input of the world’s finest guitarists such as Clapton, Springsteen, Cray, Gilmour, Townshend, Wilko Johnson and Stevie Ray Vaughan, to name just a few.

The History of the Telecaster

The rich history of Fender guitars begins with the Telecaster. An indispensable instrument, the Telecaster was the world’s first successful solid-body electric guitar. Perfected after two years of development – and a name change or two – the Telecaster debuted in February 1951 and began its steady ascent towards the stage and studio. Ingeniously engineered with the ability to be heard both loud and clear, it was a marvel of simple design elegance and workhorse functionality. It is perhaps fitting testimony to its essential original rightness that the Telecaster design has hardly changed ever since.

listings.model: Fender Custom Shop LTD 69 Stratocaster Relic
listings.title: Fender Fender Custom Shop LTD 69 Stratocaster Relic  2014 - Black Over Three Tone Sunburst (COD 2253UG)
listings.description:
The 2014 Fender Custom Shop LTD ’69 Stratocaster Relic (Black Over Three-Tone Sunburst) is a truly unconventional Stratocaster, blending the aesthetic and charm of late-1960s Fender models with a configuration designed for greater power, stability, and versatility.
The alder body features a nitrocellulose finish in a spectacular "Black Over Three-Tone Sunburst" Relic style. The aging process allows the underlying Three-Tone Sunburst to peek through the black top coat, creating a striking, character-filled look that perfectly embodies the spirit of the Custom Shop’s most unique offerings.
The maple neck features a nitro finish and a "60s Style Oval C" profile—comfortable and familiar, yet substantial enough to feel solid in the hand. The AAA rosewood fretboard boasts a 9.5" radius, a 25.5" scale length, and 21 "6000 Jumbo" frets; this combination makes the instrument particularly responsive for string bending and modern playing styles. It has a nut width of 42.8 mm, and the locking nut works in tandem with the Floyd Rose system to ensure superior tuning stability, even with aggressive use of the tremolo arm.
The electronics follow an HSS configuration. A Seymour Duncan Trembucker sits at the bridge, offering more body, compression, and output than a traditional Stratocaster single-coil, while the middle and neck positions are handled by two Fender Strat Tex pickups, preserving the classic Stratocaster brightness, openness, and dynamic response. A five-way selector switch allows for quick transitions between classic, crystalline tones and more aggressive sounds suited for heavy distortion.
The Floyd Rose tremolo bridge, paired with the locking nut, makes this Strat ideal for players who make heavy use of the vibrato arm without wanting to sacrifice tuning stability. The hardware is chrome-plated, and "White Relic" knobs perfectly complement the instrument's "played-in" aesthetic. Weighing in at 3.545 kg, this Custom Shop model retains a solid, substantial feel without sacrificing the immediate response expected of a fine Stratocaster.
It is a guitar with a distinct dual personality: aesthetically, it instantly evokes the Fender era of the late 1960s, yet it offers decidedly modern features under the fingers. Jumbo frets, a 9.5" radius, a bridge humbucker, and a Floyd Rose tremolo make it a true player's instrument, designed for those seeking a Strat capable of venturing far beyond traditional territory.
A unique, striking, and extremely versatile Fender Custom Shop model—ideal both for musicians seeking a professional instrument with modern specs and for those desiring a collectible Custom Shop piece with a configuration far less common than standard vintage reissues.
Comes complete with case, certificate, and original tags. Available at Guitar Sauce in Italy, with worldwide shipping options.

Jensen original speaker is in amp.

So This was in a time capsule from 1966 November: a never used amp; before me. I have used it in a home recording sessions occasionally. It is in mint condition. Ready for studio players and musicians. And the Original Output transformer is in the amp. Original Blue ones are there too! It is fully serviced, safe, and ready to play. Jensen original speaker is in amp. Generally speaking, the Jensen offers superior clarity, a richer low end, and punchier volume, whereas vintage Oxfords are often perceived as middling or flabby when pushed. 

Non-reverb Princetons have more clean headroom, punch, and a purer tone than the reverb models-studio engineers love them for this. And it is a brilliant pedal platform

This blackface circuit AA964 was used in 1964 -1967

As Vintage Guitar Magazine writes:"This kept it all crisp and pristine on the way to the phase inverter, with little in line to push the amp into overdrive; therein lies the beauty of this circuit for certain playing styles.Though so often the underdog on the vintage market, the non-reverb Princeton ultimately reveals a thing of sonic beauty, and displays more of the characteristic that helped make black-panel Fenders legendary performers in the first place – some of the sweetest, liveliest clean tones ever produced this side of the Atlantic."
